## Environment

- Project version / commit:
- macOS version and chip family:
- Ethernet adapter and router model:
- Fresh generic installation or a different deployment:

## Expected and observed behavior

Include the steps, whether the host and actual downstream client were tested, and whether a proxy was enabled. Distinguish DNS, connectivity and application errors.

## Sanitized evidence

Include only relevant status and error excerpts. Remove personal paths, usernames, MAC addresses, service UUIDs, SSIDs and actual network addresses. Do not attach passwords, keys, router sessions, subscriptions, complete configuration, raw captures or recovery directories.

## Recovery

State whether the network recovered and what actions were actually taken. Do not perform destructive network tests merely to fill out this report.
